title: An In-vitro Real-time System Based on Tissue Smears to Identify Malignancy During Hysteroscopic Procedure
brief_summary: The aim of the current study is to develop a near real-time system using infrared spectroscopy, that will evaluate the histological specimen that was removed from the uterine cavity during the hysteroscopy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients undergoing hysteroscopy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnancy
